verdict.rationale: The Registrar API allows programmatic management of domains, which implies you can read domain data out as JSON. The lock documentation says domains stay locked until you choose to unlock them, which implies a path to transfer out. Community reports describe lock-in from the required use of Cloudflare nameservers, but nothing shows that leaving actually fails. missing for 10: documented transfer-out/auth-code procedure, an explicit bulk export of domain, WHOIS and DNS data in open formats, and independent hands-on reports of leaving Cloudflare Registrar.
